recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Future changes to profiling discriminator semantics should be handled under their own Jira decisions; FHIR-14543 itself needs no further source work.
issue_request: FHIR-14543 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 clarification for the FHIR-core profiling page asking that the discriminator text read as an explicit either/or/or sequence by adding an extra 'or' between ElementDefinition.fixed[x] and ElementDefinition.pattern[x].
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was applied in SVN revision 13406. Git history maps this to commit 6d93d48f5accea018bd02d8936d6c7f4572f9fc8, 'GF#14543 - grammar fix', which added ', or' after ElementDefinition.fixed[x] in source/profiling.html.
additional_context: Later commit 825e0e7be86ee9ab97c75aa16c05f09a5404c644 refactored the same discriminator sentence into a bullet list while preserving the explicit 'or' after both ElementDefinition.fixed[x] and ElementDefinition.pattern[x]. The current source/profiling.html page still carries that bullet-list wording. Exact Zulip key and Confluence Jira-reference searches found no direct FHIR-14543 community records, and broader discriminator searches found no conflict with this editorial decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active profiling source already expresses the requested grammar.

related_jiras.note: A later same-paragraph profiling-language refactor preserved the FHIR-14543 wording; it was used only as context and was not independently decided.
